title: Apple Reminders bidirectional adapter configuration
description: Per-household configuration consumed by packs/adapters/reminders/apple-eventkit/adapter.py at start(). The Reminders adapter does not use a 1Password reference — EventKit access is granted at the OS level via EKEventStore.requestFullAccessToReminders (prompt 16 bootstrap-wizard wires the grant). sensitivity_floor is a hardcoded const `"normal"` at the pack level per SYSTEM_INVARIANTS.md §6 invariant 10 — adapters never auto-elevate, so any config that tries to raise it to `"privileged"` is rejected by JSON-schema validation before the loader runs. The never-sync filter is the per-item privacy boundary applied at BOTH inbound and outbound boundaries inside the adapter.

target_list_identifier.description: The iCloud Reminders list identifier (EKCalendar.calendarIdentifier) that AdministrateMe writes household-tagged reminders to on the 30s outbound loop. Inbound polls fetch from ALL non-never-sync lists; outbound writes go only to this list.

member_id.description: Household member who owns the EventKit grant for this adapter instance. Stamped onto every reminder.list_item.synced event so downstream consumers can owner-scope correctly.

deployment_target.description: Dual-deployment runtime selector per [D18] / [D22] / memo 05 §5.4 (11b-ii-α-2). `central` (default, backwards-compatible): adapter runs on the shared CoS Apple ID and emits via ctx.event_log.append; sharing_model_discriminator value `shared_central`. `bridge`: adapter runs on a per-member bridge Mac Mini signed into that member's iCloud; the bridge connector-pack wrapper (bridge/adminme_bridge/connector_packs/reminders_apple_eventkit_bridge/) injects an IngestClientBridgeSink into the synthesized AdapterContext so the adapter emits via the α-1 bridge sink; sharing_model_discriminator value `per_member_isolated`. Pre-α-2 configs that omit this field default to `central` so existing instances keep working.

never_sync_list_substrings.description: List names containing any of these substrings (case-insensitive) are blocked from sync at BOTH boundaries. Default matches the canonical never-sync rules in BUILD.md APPLE REMINDERS BIDIRECTIONAL §"Never-sync rules".

never_sync_tag_substrings.description: Reminders whose title or notes contain any of these substrings (case-insensitive) are blocked from sync at BOTH boundaries. Default is the canonical `#private` tag.

inbound_poll_interval_s.description: Seconds between inbound EventKit fetch cycles. The supervisor's APScheduler cron is a 1-minute heartbeat; the in-process cadence here is the active polling cadence.

outbound_poll_interval_s.description: Seconds between outbound EventKit write batches. The adapter drains queued upstream events (`reminder.dispatched` / `task.created` / `commitment.proposed`) at this cadence to minimize iCloud sync churn.

sensitivity_floor.description: Hardcoded constant per SYSTEM_INVARIANTS.md §6 invariant 10 — reminders adapters cannot be elevated to `"privileged"` via config (auto-elevation is a deliberate operator decision for a future prompt). JSON-schema validation rejects any other value.
